plain_text:
Howard Duff appears in 88 recordings across 15 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1942 to 1979. The credits here include performer, announcer, host, afrs announcer, and unknown.

In this archive, you will hear Howard Duff most often in The Adventures of Sam Spade, Duffy's Tavern, Sears Radio Theater, The Whistler, Encore Theater, Molle Mystery Theatre, The Adventures of the Thin Man, and The Great Gildersleeve.

Characters credited here include Sam Spade and Philip Karney.
